title: Summary of the Situation
text: Then, as the night wore on, my father came into my room—where I was just about to go to sleep—looking flustered.
“Let me stay here!”
“What’s the matter?”
Yuki-chan is already asleep, and Kou is sleeping in the castle garden. So there’s a free bed.
“Somehow, Melty-chan got talked into coming to my room by the queen! She’s wearing really sheer clothes… a negligee, is that what it’s called? She’s wearing that.”
“What? Has my finacée turned into a nymphomaniac?! How could this happen, even though I have Filo-tan here?!”

According to my Father, she came at him muttering something like, “If it’s the Shield Hero…” Ugh… that finacée of mine. Even though she has a finacée named Filo-tan, she’s trying to steal even my Father away from me.
“Melty-chan’s still a kid, so I can’t let her do something like that. I asked Sakura-chan to help her calm down, but who knows what she’ll do next!”
“I see—so you’re asking me to keep an eye on her!”
“Um… yeah, could you do that for me?”
“Understood.”

If it’s a request from my Father, I, Motoyasu, will stay awake all night to protect him no matter what. If I’m the bodyguard, things will generally work out just fine. In fact, unless they bring someone on Father’s level, I won’t lose.
“Sorry for asking the impossible.”
“What are you talking about? We’re close, you and I.”
“Well, that’s true… Motoyasu, can we talk for a bit before you go to sleep?”
“What’s on your mind? Are you asking for advice on the ‘Motoyasu Route’?”
“Why do I have to ‘conquer’ Motoyasu-kun!”
“Then what kind of talk is this?”

Are you planning to discuss the future with my Father? There’s quite a discrepancy between that and what I know. I never would have imagined that my Father would be installed as the King of Melromarc. Now that these unexpected events have occurred, it’s only natural to discuss what comes next.
“Well, at any rate, this ending turned out quite different from what Motoyasu-kun’s story predicted.”
“That’s true. In the future, my Father wasn’t elevated to this level.”
“…I wonder if it’s because he did too many good deeds? Well, I did think the king’s fate was nothing but ‘serves him right.’”
“He brought it on himself.”
“That’s fine, but we need to start thinking about our plan moving forward.”
“Quite so. We’ll have to make sure pigs don’t come near where my father is sleeping. And then there’s the finacée, too.”
It’s outrageous that she’d go after my father, even though she has a finacée named Filo-tan.

“Well… I mean, it’s fine to admire a young girl, but a physical relationship is a step too far… He claimed to be an otaku, but when it actually came down to it, he lost his appetite. I guess it’ll be a while before I can treat Melty-chan as a romantic partner.”
“Come to think of it—I seem to recall hearing that there was talk of an arranged marriage with your Finacée even in the future.”
“So there really was talk about Melty-chan after all?”
“There certainly was.”
Hmm? When I recall that scene, it seemed like your Father and that Trash had made up. That’s a scenario that seems absolutely impossible given how things are now.
“Both your Finacée and your Father were against it. So I suppose the matter just fizzled out, didn’t it?”
“But Melty-chan’s really into it now… It was quite a struggle to get away from her, too.”
Father is muttering to himself about how to put it off.
“Come to think of it, there are way too many young girls around me. Maybe because I’ve gotten used to it, I’m starting to lose the ability to see them as members of the opposite sex.”

He mutters under his breath, “So I wasn’t a lolicon after all…” as he seems to be lamenting something. Lolicon… I’ve heard there’s slang like that. I’m not really familiar with that sort of thing, so I don’t know much about it, but isn’t it a preference for having romantic feelings toward young children?
…In other words, I’m a lolicon. After all, Filo-tan looks just like a young angel. Well, I do love Filo-tan in her “Filolial Queen” form, too.

“A-anyway, let’s think about what’s coming next. If I recall correctly, after leveling up on Cal Mira Island, the heroes—including Motoyasu-kun but excluding me—unseal the Spirit Tortoise, which leads to a major incident, right?”
“That’s right. After unsealing it, I, Ren, and Itsuki are defeated by the Spirit Tortoise and each flee.”

I’m reminded of the miserable life I led after being defeated by the Spirit Tortoise. Ordinary people threw stones at us, the Crimson Swine and Lazy Pigs abandoned us—I was utterly despairing. And then came the encouragement from Filo-tan, whom I happened to meet. It’s still a deeply moving episode even now.
“So, after I somehow manage to defeat the Spirit Tortoise… the waves will stop coming for a while. Isn’t that when we’re supposed to rebuild the village where Keel-kun used to live?”
“That’s absolutely right. In the midst of that reconstruction, incidents occurred in the order of Ren, me, and Itsuki, leading us to settle in Father’s territory and strive for true peace.”

“Yeah. Then, we challenged the Phoenix but were thwarted, suffering heavy casualties. We then faced off against Takt and Faubrey—the very ones responsible for the interference—and after being routed, a war broke out. We fought again in Melromarc and emerged victorious… was that right?”
“That’s right.”
“What happened after that?”

At Father’s prompting, I search my memory. After sharing the methods for strengthening the Four Holy Warriors and the Seven Star Warriors and gaining immense power, we challenged the Wave. As for what happened next…
“I can’t quite remember.”
I believe we were in peak condition. I can’t imagine us, in that state, losing to something like the Wave…
“So, we must have lost after that. I don’t know if we were defeated by the Wave or if it was due to some other factor, though.”
“So, what should we do?”
“I think I’ve mentioned this before, but we shouldn’t let that Spirit Tortoise’s seal be broken so easily. There were a lot of casualties, right?”
“That’s true.”

“Then we should prevent it as much as possible. The Queen said that when you head to a place called Cal Mira Island, the heroes should discuss things among themselves, right? We’ll just have to warn them not to go at that time… I suppose.”
“Do you think Ren and Itsuki will listen to us?”

Itsuki, for one reason or another, harbors some resentment toward my Father and me. On the other hand, Ren seems to have misunderstood Father’s explanation, thinking it’s just a difference in weapon specifications. We can’t enhance their weapons unless they believe us. It’s a tricky problem.

“Well… it’ll be tough, but we’ve got no choice but to try. Fortunately, since Keel and Wyndia are also enhanced by the power of their weapons, I’d like to think they’ll believe us. Worst-case scenario, we’ll have to subdue them—even if it means restraining them—to prevent them from breaking the Spirit Tortoise’s seal.”
“Understood.”

In other words, after we’re done with Cal Mira Island, we’ll have to capture Ren and Itsuki so they don’t act on their own. Just like Itsuki did this time. I’m really looking forward to this. Let’s start thinking about where to confine them next.
“As peacefully as possible, if we can.”
“I’ll do my best.”

“And if that goes well, we’ll take on the waves from each nation while exposing Takt’s conspiracy and dealing with him swiftly. We have to make sure it doesn’t turn into a war with Shieldfreeden. Hmm? What’s the situation with Faubrey again?”

“In the first world, the representative from Faubrey was killed, but in the previous cycle, it seems he was still alive. Since the Queen of Melromarc also came with reinforcements to stop the war… I don’t think Faubrey was involved.”

“In other words, the King of Faubrey will be killed within the three months following the Spirit Tortoise Incident. Until then, after we’ve defeated Takt, let’s figure out a way to prevent a war from breaking out.”

The problem when we kill Takt will be that woman of the Aotatsu race—the representative of Shieldfreeden. It seems like we just need to make sure she doesn’t escape and take her out, but I wonder if that’s really the case? The real issue is that Takt’s female henchwomen will run amok seeking revenge.
Even if we avoid war, there’s no telling when my Father and the others might be targeted. Figuring out how to handle this will be our challenge moving forward.

“It sounds like we’re counting our chickens before they’re hatched, but since that incident seems to have caused quite a stir, we need to figure out a way to avoid it… Yeah, we’ve got a mountain of immediate challenges ahead of us.”
“That’s exactly why we’re going to Cal Mira Island to take a breather and refresh ourselves before tackling this.”
“That’s true. I should probably learn the support magic found on Cal Mira Island, too.”

Come to think of it, my Father was the most skilled user of support magic among the Four Holy Heroes. When under the effect of the support magic he used, we can become far stronger than we are now. Of course, even I can’t imitate or reproduce that magnificent support magic.
“I still can’t use Liberation like Motoyasu-kun yet…”

Although he’s learned the Way of the Dragon Vein from his Rival, my father laments that he still can’t cast Magic effectively in various situations. Mastering Liberation is surprisingly difficult, after all.
“Anyway, let’s do our best.”
“Yes, sir!”
“Speaking of which, Motoyasu-kun. What happened to the Filolial eggs?”
“They’re right here.”

I show my Father the wooden box containing the Filolial-sama eggs that I’ve been carefully carrying with me. Of course, I’ve already reported to him that we recovered them from the Three Heroes Church.
“There are quite a few of them. What are you going to do with them?”
“I’m going to raise them, of course. I hope Filo-tan is in here somewhere.”
Ah, I wonder where Filo-tan is? All I can do is pray she’s in here.
“In that case, since we’re heading to Cal Mira Island tomorrow, this works out perfectly, doesn’t it?”
“Oh! That’s just right.”

The downside is that there’s no Dragon Hourglass on Cal Mira Island, so we’ll have to wait until we return from the island to do a Class Up. Well, we’ll just have to be patient about that. It’s not like we’ll have any problems for a while even without doing a Class Up.

“So we’ll have 100 more Filolials… Well, the food shortage is getting resolved, the kingdom is arranging housing for us, and we’ll be rebuilding the village where Keel-kun used to live—so maybe this is just the right timing?”
“Indeed!”
And so, after discussing our future plans with my Father, I went to bed.
